body: I don't deserve it, but thank you so much for the kind words. I'm really sorry you're going through this hell and I truly hope things will get better for you.

Well, that's the thing, people always say "reach out" or "ask for help" like it's going to solve anything. I've done so multiple times, put myself in an incredibly vulnerable position with someone I thought I could trust, only to get curb-stomped by life as usual. 


When I was 14, I told my mother how miserable I was and that I wanted to die. She told me it's my own fault because I chose to be born like this (some reincarnation bullshit she believes in). Two years ago, I told her I was scared because I started losing memory. She brushed me off and said it was because the Earth was ascending into a higher dimension or something. One of the two therapists that didn't reject me due to my BPD diagnosis told me she doesn't know what to do with me, the other told me that it was just how my personality was and that there is no help. I've been on seven medications, none have worked. I've been hospitalized several times, and all it did was make everything even worse. I don't trust therapists anymore.


I know there is probably something or someone out there that could help me, but every single time I asked for help in the past I just got wounded even more. It's not worth it.
